`ConfigManager::getInventoryPaths()` public API returns inventory path(s) for a given unexpanded location code. 

Why can't we convert the expanded location code to unexpanded location code and use the `ConfigManager` API? This avoids a D-Bus call and looping through a map of managed objects to search for a match.
This API retrieves FRUs based on the expanded location code. For unexpanded location codes, a separate API is available. We may revisit and utilize that API in the future if required.
As agreed. We will keep this implementation for now and revisit this.
